rule: Common Control Bases own reusable behavior. Skinned Widgets add exact GFx presentation. Panel Instances own placement, content, and semantic binding. Texture scope is independent from skin scope.
skinScopePolicy: A skin belongs to one UI locally until at least two approved UI reworks verify the same GFx name, base class, state/style contract, and decoded pixel hashes. Only then move it to Shared Skinned Widgets. Pending or unreworked UI usage is not promotion evidence.
sourceVariantPolicy: Reuse exact decoded pixels or an explicitly owner-approved visual equivalent. Preserve the original GFx reference and approval; do not recreate aliased pixels.
atlasSamplingPolicy: Preserve every FFDec crop exactly at its catalog rectangle and extrude its nearest edge pixel into the unused one-pixel atlas gutter so linear filtering cannot create join seams.
scaleGridPolicy: Generate every part rectangle from the owning GFx symbol bounds, scale grid, fill bounds, and instance transform. Use a generic tiled-box only when those authored rectangles form a regular grid; never force irregular GFx parts flush to a panel edge.

commonControlBases.stateBehavior: Native :hover/:active and common disabled/selected state select authored child art. GFx text states retain native pointer selectors.
